text:
Rafael: hi all, Rafael here (platform). Day 1. Trying to get Vault read + KMS unwrap for a local prototype. Who do I ping and what's the fastest path?

devex-bot: Welcome Rafael! Quick guide: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/secrets. Short summary: for dev/demo access, open a 'vault-access' issue in infra with team, secret prefixes, access level (read/write), and manager approval screenshot or @mention. For KMS test usage, post in #eng-security with purpose and TTL.

Rafael: Can I get a temp token instead of waiting for issue triage? Need it for a lunchtime demo.

Nina: @Rafael we usually provide 8-24h scoped tokens for new hires. DM me the exact prefixes you need and I'll create one with policy `newhire:dev`. Example command we use internally if you have enough perms:

  vault token create -policy=newhire:dev -ttl=8h -display-name="rafael.laptop"

Rafael: Thanks @Nina. Prefs: read-only to secret/data/feature-x/* and transit-decrypt for KMS unwraps.

SecurityBot: Note: production service keys are NOT available via temp tokens. If you need production KMS keys, file request with service owner and include rotation plan. See policy: https://redwood.internal/security/kms-policy.

Elena: Also: add a short note in your onboarding doc listing every secret path you touched and why. That helps audits later.

Nina: Created an 12h token and DMed you the value. You should also be in the 'feature-x' Vault group for UI visibility; check with `vault login $TOKEN` then `vault kv get secret/data/feature-x/sample`.

Rafael: I can read the sample, thanks! Two follow-ups: 1) if I create a demo secret wrapped with a KMS key, how do we rotate it? 2) who signs off for longer-term access?

Elena: Rotation (short): 1) create a new key version in KMS (or new key) 2) run our rewrap tool (infra/tools/rewrap_kms.sh) to re-encrypt Vault values 3) deploy services referencing the new key 4) after verification, revoke old key version. For production rotations we require a ticket in infra with the owner, rollback plan, and a scheduled maintenance window.

SecurityBot: Rotation cadence: service keys = 90 days, high-sensitive = 30 days. Automated reminders are sent 10 days before expiry. Manual emergency rotation requires owner + security approval.

Rafael: Great, that's clear. @Elena who approves production KMS access?

Elena: Production KMS access needs three approvals: service owner, your manager, and Eng Security. If the key is cross-team we may add infra SRE. I can be the manager approver for your initial request.

Rafael: Perfect — opening the vault-access issue now and will ping the thread with the link. Appreciate the quick help :party_popper:
